description: This file contains the implementation of a diff/merge viewer component for CodeMirror, including classes and functions for diff visualization, synchronization, and user interaction within a code merging interface.

classes.name: DiffView
classes.description: Represents a diff view component within the merge interface, managing diff calculations, rendering, and synchronization between original and modified code panes.

classes.name: TrackAlignable
classes.description: Tracks lines and widgets in a CodeMirror instance to facilitate alignment and synchronization during diff operations.

classes.name: MergeView
classes.description: Main class for the code merge interface, managing multiple DiffView instances, user interactions, and layout.

methods.name: getDiff
methods.description: Computes the diff between two strings using the diff_match_patch library.

methods.name: getChunks
methods.description: Generates chunks representing differences from a diff array.

methods.name: alignableFor
methods.description: Determines lines in an editor that are alignable with their counterparts in another editor.

methods.name: mergeAlignable
methods.description: Merges alignable line information between two sets of lines.

methods.name: findAlignedLines
methods.description: Finds lines that should be aligned between two diff views.

methods.name: alignChunks
methods.description: Aligns chunks of code between diff views for better comparison.
